nfe003dbf37.headline: Staropramen Breweries reduced loss to 82 million two years ago - Novinky
nfe003dbf37.summary: The Czech Republic's second-largest beer producer, Staropramen Breweries, cut its loss by 1.2 billion crowns to 82 million crowns two years ago, with operating results before depreciation falling by 6% to 2.2 billion crowns.
nfe003dbf37.why: Staropramen is a key player in the Czech beverage sector; its financial performance reflects industry trends and consumer demand in Central Europe.

n843f315a7a.headline: Carlos Ghosn: The court rejects the bail request
n843f315a7a.summary: The Tokyo court denied bail for Carlos Ghosn, CEO of Renault, citing risk of evidence destruction in his financial misconduct investigation.
n843f315a7a.why: Carlos Ghosn is a high-profile automotive executive; legal issues affect Renault's governance and investor confidence.
